hotspots.name: Taiwan Strait
hotspots.summary: Ongoing China-Taiwan tensions. PLA military exercises have increased in frequency. US 7th Fleet maintains regular transits.
hotspots.scenario: Escalation scenario: Gold +15–20% (safe haven demand), AUD -8–12% (risk-off, China trade exposure), semiconductor supply chain disruption, shipping rerouted via Cape of Good Hope adding 2–3 weeks transit.

hotspots.name: Middle East / Strait of Hormuz
hotspots.summary: Iran-Israel tensions elevated. Houthi attacks on Red Sea shipping ongoing. ~20% of global oil supply passes through Strait of Hormuz.
hotspots.scenario: Strait closure scenario: Brent +30–50%, Gold +10–15% (oil inflation = real asset demand), AUD neutral (commodity tailwind vs risk-off offset), LNG spot prices spike.

hotspots.name: Ukraine / Eastern Europe
hotspots.summary: Russia-Ukraine war ongoing. NATO weapons supply, sanctions pressure on Russian energy exports. Wheat and fertiliser supply disruption.
hotspots.scenario: Escalation to NATO involvement: Gold +20–30%, EUR -5%, energy crisis in Europe, AUD mild bullish (commodity safe haven), risk-off global.

hotspots.name: South China Sea
hotspots.summary: Territorial disputes between China, Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia. US freedom of navigation operations. Spratly and Paracel Islands contested.
hotspots.scenario: Incident scenario: Regional de-escalation likely. Shipping impact minimal — sea lanes remain open. AUD -3–5% on China risk-off.

hotspots.name: Red Sea / Suez Choke Point
hotspots.summary: Houthi missile and drone attacks on commercial vessels since Oct 2023. Most major shipping lines rerouting via Cape of Good Hope. Transit times +2–3 weeks, freight costs elevated.
hotspots.scenario: Full closure: Global freight costs +40%, inflation pressure, Gold mild bullish. LNG tankers most impacted. Restoration would require sustained Houthi ceasefire.

hotspots.name: Strait of Malacca
hotspots.summary: World's busiest shipping lane. ~90,000 vessels/year. Connects Indian Ocean to South China Sea. Piracy risk remains low. Closure would be catastrophic for Asian trade.
hotspots.scenario: Blockade scenario (extreme): Global trade collapse, Gold +30%+, AUD -15% (China exports crushed), oil rationing in Japan/South Korea/China.

shipping_lanes.name: Cape of Good Hope Route (current diversion)

mining_regions.name: Australian Goldfields (WA)
mining_regions.notes: Kalgoorlie Super Pit, Boddington. ~320t/yr. Relatively stable jurisdiction.

mining_regions.name: South Africa — Witwatersrand
mining_regions.notes: Deep-level mining, high costs, power outages (Eskom). ~90t/yr declining.

mining_regions.name: Ghana — Ashanti Belt
mining_regions.notes: ~130t/yr. Political risk moderate. Newmont, AngloGold operations.

mining_regions.name: Nevada Gold Triangle (USA)
mining_regions.notes: Carlin Trend, Cortez. Barrick/Nevada Gold Mines. ~180t/yr.

mining_regions.name: Russia — Siberia / Magadan
mining_regions.notes: ~330t/yr. Sanctioned — output continues but export channels disrupted. Polyus main producer.

mining_regions.name: China — Shandong / Yunnan
mining_regions.notes: ~370t/yr. State-controlled, domestic consumption. Zijin, Shandong Gold.

australia.name: WA Goldfields — Kalgoorlie Super Pit
australia.summary: World's richest gold belt. Kalgoorlie Super Pit (~600koz/yr) — 3.5km wide open-cut, visible from space. Also Boddington, Granny Smith, Tropicana. ~320t/yr total WA output.
australia.aud_link: Direct — WA gold royalties, AUD earns on USD gold price. Rising gold = AUD support.
australia.key_names: NST, EVN, RMS, RRL, WAF, BGL, CMM

australia.name: Pilbara — Mt Whaleback Iron Ore
australia.summary: Largest iron ore province globally. Mt Whaleback (BHP) is the world's largest open-cut iron ore mine — 5km x 1.5km. BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue export ~900Mt/yr combined.
australia.aud_link: Iron ore is AUD's primary driver. Iron ore price ↑10% ≈ AUD ↑2–3%. China steel demand = key watchpoint.

australia.name: Port Hedland — Iron Ore Export Terminal
australia.summary: World's largest bulk export port. ~600Mt iron ore/yr shipped to China, Japan, South Korea. Cyclone closures (Nov–Apr) cause price spikes.
australia.aud_link: Port disruption → immediate iron ore price spike → short-term AUD volatility. Monitor BOM cyclone alerts.

australia.name: Pilgangoora — Lithium (Spodumene)
australia.summary: Pilgangoora (Pilbara Minerals) — world's largest hard-rock lithium operation. Also Greenbushes (IGO/Albemarle/Tianqi) ~680kt/yr spodumene. Australia supplies ~50% of global supply. EV battery demand driver.
australia.aud_link: Lithium price cycle driven by EV demand and Chinese battery makers. Tightening = AUD positive. Oversupply (2024) = pressure on AUD miners.

australia.name: Olympic Dam — Copper/Uranium/Gold (SA)
australia.summary: BHP's Olympic Dam: world's largest uranium deposit, major copper and gold by-product. Expansion to open-cut would be transformational for BHP and SA economy.
australia.aud_link: Uranium prices rising on nuclear renaissance narrative. Copper = electrification demand. Both AUD-positive.

australia.name: Mount Isa — Copper, Zinc, Lead (QLD)
australia.summary: Glencore's Mount Isa mines: major copper, zinc, lead producer. Connected to Townsville port by 900km rail. One of world's largest polymetallic operations.
australia.aud_link: Copper = global economic bellwether. Zinc/lead = construction demand. Weak China = pressure. Energy transition = copper demand structural tailwind.

australia.name: Darwin Port — Critical Infrastructure
australia.summary: Leased to Chinese company Landbridge (99yr lease, 2015). Strategic gateway for NT minerals and proximity to SE Asia. US military base at RAAF Darwin. Geopolitical tension over lease.
australia.aud_link: NT manganese and LNG exports. Geopolitical risk if Sino-Australian relations deteriorate — lease review ongoing.

australia.name: WA Nickel Belt — Kambalda / Kalgoorlie
australia.summary: Historical nickel belt now under severe stress. Indonesian low-cost nickel flooded market (2023–24). BHP closed Nickel West. IGO wrote down Cosmos. Structural oversupply from laterite HPAL.
australia.aud_link: Nickel price collapse (-40% in 2024) hit AUD miners hard. EV battery demand long-term positive but timeline uncertain vs Indonesian supply.

asx_projects.name: Northern Star Resources
asx_projects.summary: ~1.6Moz/yr. Australia's largest gold producer. KCGM (Kalgoorlie Super Pit) is 50% JV with Saracen post-merger. Also operates Yandal Belt and Pogo mine (Alaska).

asx_projects.name: Evolution Mining
asx_projects.summary: ~760koz/yr. Diversified Australian gold producer. Cowal is flagship. Red Lake (Canada) added in 2022. Ernest Henry copper-gold stream.

asx_projects.name: Ramelius Resources
asx_projects.summary: ~250koz/yr. Mid-tier WA gold producer. Mt Magnet and Edna May are operating hubs. Growing pipeline of WA projects.

asx_projects.name: Regis Resources
asx_projects.summary: ~450koz/yr. WA-focused gold miner. Duketon operations (Garden Well, Rosemont) in the Yilgarn. McPhillamys project (NSW) in development.

asx_projects.name: Bellevue Gold
asx_projects.summary: ~200koz/yr target. High-grade underground gold project in WA Yilgarn, now in production ramp-up. High grade (10+ g/t Au).

asx_projects.name: Capricorn Metals
asx_projects.summary: ~100koz/yr from Karlawinda. Low-cost open-pit WA producer. Mt Gibson development stage. No debt.

asx_projects.name: Catalyst Metals
asx_projects.summary: Victorian gold producer. Henty mine (Tasmania). Sullivan and other VIC projects. Small-cap leverage to gold.

asx_projects.name: West African Resources
asx_projects.summary: ~300koz/yr from Sanbrado (Burkina Faso). Low-cost African producer with M1 South high-grade underground mine. Kiaka development project 45km south (~3Moz resource). Political risk: Burkina Faso military government since 2022. Permit polygons are estimated from published permit areas — not official surveyed boundaries.

asx_projects.name: Lynas Rare Earths
asx_projects.summary: World's largest rare earths producer outside China. Mt Weld mine (WA) → processing at Kuantan (Malaysia). Critical to EV motors, defence. Strategic national interest.

asx_projects.name: Pilbara Minerals
asx_projects.summary: World's largest hard-rock lithium operation. Pilgangoora project (Pilbara, WA). ~680kt spodumene/yr. Highly leveraged to lithium price cycle.

asx_projects.name: IGO Limited
asx_projects.summary: Nickel and lithium producer. Nova Nickel (WA). 49% stake in Greenbushes lithium (with Tianqi/Albemarle). Cosmos nickel suspended (2024 write-down).

asx_projects.name: Mineral Resources
asx_projects.summary: Diversified mining company + mining services. Wodgina lithium, Mt Marion lithium, Onslow iron ore (new port). BHP JV iron ore in Pilbara.

asx_projects.name: BHP Group
asx_projects.summary: World's largest diversified miner. Iron ore (Pilbara), copper (Olympic Dam, Escondida), potash (Jansen, Canada). Nickel West mothballed 2024.

asx_projects.name: Rio Tinto
asx_projects.summary: Major diversified miner. Pilbara iron ore is largest division. Oyu Tolgoi copper (Mongolia). Rincon lithium (Argentina). Simandou iron ore (Guinea) — in development.

asx_projects.name: Fortescue
asx_projects.summary: Third-largest iron ore producer globally. Cloudbreak, Christmas Creek, Iron Bridge magnetite. All in Pilbara. Pivoting to green hydrogen (FFI).

asx_projects.name: Meeka Metals — Murchison Gold Project
asx_projects.summary: WA gold developer near Meekatharra. Murchison Gold Project holds the Nannine, Bluebird, Turnberry and Ajax deposits. ~1.5Moz resource. Development decision pending. Tenement data sourced from WA DMIRS (NM Gold Operations Pty Ltd).

asx_projects.name: Perenti
asx_projects.summary: Mining services company. Surface and underground contracting for gold and base metal mines. Operations across WA, Africa (West and East), and Middle East.
